inventory.title: Inventory management
inventory.headerSubtitle: Search player inventories, manage restore points, and monitor live sessions
inventory.intro: Decides who manages player inventories when they enter arena and event worlds.
inventory.descAuto: The plugin backs inventories up through InventoryBackup and restores them automatically after matches, events, deaths and disconnects. Multiverse-Inventories is not needed.
inventory.descLegacy: Second choice: Multiverse-Inventories swaps the inventory on world change. This plugin never restores anything on its own, and the conflict guard does not apply here — if a world group is missing or wrong, the loss is final.
inventory.legacyWarning: Legacy mode is unstable in combination with matches and events: the plugin hands the inventory over on the world change and never takes it back. Only use it if there is truly no other way.
inventory.coexistenceWarning: Multiverse-Inventories is running alongside the plugin's own management. Both swap the same inventory:
inventory.missingWarning: The InventoryBackup API is not available. Matches and events are refused until it is, so that no inventory is cleared without a backup.
inventory.warnMatchEndOff: Off: the inventory is still backed up, but never given back after a match. Players keep the kit until an admin restores it by hand.
inventory.warnEventEndOff: Off: participants leave the event with the kit. Their survival inventory stays in the backup until an admin restores it by hand.
inventory.warnRespawnOff: Off: whoever dies in an arena respawns without their survival inventory. It only exists in the backup from then on.
inventory.warnRejoinOff: Off: anyone who loses connection mid-match gets nothing back on their next join. Of the four switches this is the one that loses the most items.
inventory.warnFailurePolicyWarn: “Continue and warn”: matches start even when no backup reached the disk. The only remaining net is the in-memory copy, and it does not survive a server restart.
inventory.warnCleanupOn: On: the backup is deleted the moment the restore succeeds. If the restore put back the wrong state, there is no way back.
inventory.legacyConfirm:
Switch to Multiverse-Inventories (legacy)?

The plugin will stop restoring inventories on its own. Matches and events then depend entirely on correct Multiverse-Inventories world groups; a wrong group means real item loss.
inventory.error.openSessions: Sessions are still open — legacy mode would leave those inventories unrestorable. Wait until the running matches and events have finished.
inventory.mviNoConflicts: None of the arena and event worlds is in a Multiverse-Inventories group that swaps — no conflict found.
inventory.mviGroupsUnreadable: The world groups of Multiverse-Inventories could not be read. Whether they collide with arena and event worlds is unknown — check groups.yml by hand.
inventory.mviGuardActive: The conflict guard is active and has stepped in {count} time(s) since the server started. Dissolving the groups above remains the cleaner fix.
inventory.mviGuardInactive: The conflict guard is switched off. In a conflict, whoever writes last wins.
inventory.globalMviBannerText: This plugin manages inventories itself and no longer needs Multiverse-Inventories. As long as the mode is not set to Multiverse-Inventories, both swap the same inventory and can conflict.
